answer.rationale: Incumbent already refused a reopen and renewal therefore misses the 18% spend mandate; the low-cost quote meets cost alone. c2 is the load-bearing claim that a primary move was fast and operationally clean, which must be checked against a 14-day hard expiry and a 94% line with no buffer. c1 is treated as a contrasting stability prior, not as permission to ignore the cost constraint. Negotiate and defer do not solve expiry-plus-mandate; a second source does not by itself hit the cut. Flagging delivery-risk because utilization leaves no slack if onboarding is slower than remembered.
